description_expanded: Description Description 30A ESCAPES presents… “HP 45E Gulf Front Condo,” a beautiful Gulf-front retreat at High Pointe Resort in Seacrest Beach. This spacious 2-bedroom, 2-bath condo sleeps 6 and offers sweeping Gulf views, a private balcony and access to some of 30A's best resort amenities. Start your mornings with coffee overlooking the water, spend the afternoon on the beach with your complimentary chair setup or relax beside the lagoon-style pool. With Rosemary Beach just a short walk away and plenty of dining and shopping nearby, “HP 45E Gulf Front Condo” makes it easy to enjoy everything you love about 30A. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Gulf-Front Condo with sweeping Gulf views from the living area, private balcony and Primary King SuiteSleeps 6 Comfortably across 2 cozy bedrooms, each with its own private En-suite bathroomPrivate Gulf-Front Balcony with al fresco dining for 4, a sun lounger and beautiful views of the emerald watersHigh Pointe Resort Amenities including private beach access, lagoon-style pool, tennis, pickleball and playgroundSeasonal Beach Chair Setup Included for the 2027 season with 2 chairs and 1 umbrellaSpacious Kitchen with stainless steel appliances, generous counter space and seating for gathering*** LIVING AREAS ***The living area is designed to make the most of the view, with wall-to-wall windows overlooking the Gulf and plenty of comfortable seating to settle in after a day along 30A. Whether you're watching a movie, spending time together or stepping onto the balcony to enjoy the coastal breeze, this inviting space makes it easy to feel right at home.Spacious Gulf-front living area with wall-to-wall Gulf viewsAmple comfortable seating for relaxing and spending time togetherFlat-screen TV for movie nights and relaxed eveningsDirect access to the private Gulf-front balcony*** KITCHEN & DINING ***The spacious kitchen makes everything from quick breakfasts to family dinners easy. With stainless steel appliances, plenty of counter space and generous storage, you'll have everything you need to prepare meals during your stay. The breakfast bar and adjacent dining area offer plenty of room to gather around the table.Stainless steel appliances and ample kitchen storageGenerous counter space for preparing mealsBreakfast bar with seating for 3Dining table with seating for 4*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Both bedrooms offer comfortable accommodations and private En-suite bathrooms, giving families and small groups plenty of space to unwind. The Primary King Suite also features direct access to the Gulf-front balcony, perfect for enjoying a quiet morning overlooking the water.Primary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, Gulf-front balcony access and En-suite with dual vanities, walk-in shower and soaking tubQueen Guest Suite: Two Queen beds, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity and walk-in shower*** GULF-FRONT OUTDOOR LIVING ***The private Gulf-front balcony is one of the best places to spend time at “HP 45E Gulf Front Condo.” Enjoy breakfast overlooking the water, relax on the sun lounger with a good book or gather for dinner outdoors as the sun begins to set. With direct access from both the living area and Primary King Suite, the balcony is an inviting extension of the condo's living space.Private Gulf-front balcony with sweeping water viewsAl fresco dining table with seating for 4Sun lounger for relaxing and enjoying the coastal breezeDirect access from the living area and Primary King Suite*** RESORT AMENITIES ***High Pointe Resort offers a true resort experience while keeping the relaxed atmosphere of 30A. The gated Gulf-front property features private beach access, a beautiful lagoon-style pool and plenty of ways to spend the day without leaving the resort.Private gated beach access with a convenient boardwalk to the GulfResort-style lagoon pool with waterfalls and plenty of space to relax poolsideCrabby Steve's Gulf-front restaurant and bar located right on propertyTennis and pickleball courts plus a children's playground*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***High Pointe Resort is ideally situated along Scenic Highway 30A between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, placing some of the area's best dining, shopping and entertainment within an easy walk or bike ride. The 30A bike path runs directly in front of the resort, making it easy to explore nearby communities without getting in the car.Peddler's Pavilion just across 30A for dining, shopping and seasonal entertainmentRosemary Beach just a short walk away for boutiques, cafés, restaurants and charming streetsAlys Beach nearby for dining, beautiful architecture and scenic green spacesScenic Highway 30A bike path directly outside the resort for exploring neighboring beach communitiesEasy access to Inlet Beach, Camp Helen State Park and more of the east end of 30A*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentOne seasonal beach chair setup is included for the 2027 season and includes 2 chairs and 1 umbrellaLSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest (including High Pointe) or Alys BeachHigh Pointe HOA does not allow unregistered guests or visitors on-site*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we're committed to providing a luxurious, safe and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 guest support and an immaculate home designed for comfort, connection and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! *** Read less
